name: i2c_pullups
summary: One pair of I2C pull-ups, to the bus's rail
note: What the I2C interface rule adds to a bus that has none. The rule works out the window (rmin_ohm from the rail and the 3 mA sink current, rmax_ohm from the rise time and the bus capacitance) and the recipe takes the stocked value nearest target_ohm inside it.

requires.message: no pull-up meets both the sink current and the rise time: lower the bus capacitance or the speed

citations.quote: The maximum pullup resistance is limited by the bus capacitance (Cb) due to I2C standard rise time specifications.
